description: Use when you need one report on a domain: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) with SPF and DMARC parsed, RDAP registration for .com, .net and .org (registrar, dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /domain/report, $0.005 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For several domains use domain_report_batch; for a single mailbox use check_email_address. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.

domain.description: domain name, e.g. example.com (a URL is accepted; only its host is used). IP addresses and private or local names are refused

name: domain_report
title: Domain report
